verdict: The revised deliverable is close to ready. I found no wrong headline number, all four conclusions survive attack from both sides, and "apply nothing" is the right decision, but it needs one more wording pass because seven places can still mislead a careful owner. Toward the upload it under-discloses: "0 of 12" depends on the registered fee (the same rule form at the report's own cost estimate, 0.30bp with 0.60bp stress, lets PRESET_A US-only pass under C in 21 of 30 seeds and makes T5 and F1 "conditional"), the stacked favourable case is about +8.1 / +8.6 %p with an MS1 headline of about 24%, not the +4.5 / +5.7 the conclusion shows, and the report never says that a same-close brake is technically feasible in a futures account. The verdict is still fair: in my own runs a one-day brake slip costs PRESET_A US-only -3.9 / -7.7 %p at registered conditions and leaves +2.1 / -0.9 even in the favourable stack, it is below v1 on real night data in 2001-2014 and by 13.4 %p in 2015-2026-08, and no stored or re-run configuration reaches the owner's 30% MS1 bar (maximum 23.0% stored, about 24% stacked). The registered 0.83bp and its 2x stress are defensible because both are the upload's own base and stress values, but they are not the central cost estimate and the report should say so in one sentence. Toward T5 the report is still too generous: it never states that T5 moves 15% of capital into a zero-interest futures account, so "v1 unchanged" and "night exposure about 3.8x" are wrong (about 2.55x by day and 3.5x by night); it leads with a blended 1999-2026 gross premium while the after-cost stand-alone Sharpe (0.57, or 0.22 without 1999-2000, against a 0.55 gate) appears only in the pre-2015 report; and it implies a forward record could re-judge T5 although the observed edge would need roughly 40 to 190 years to reach t = 2. Sections 1 and 3 also report the same US-only presets under different conventions (v9 from 2015: 33.2% against 26.8%) with no warning, which invites a wrong comparison with v1's 28.1%. Conclusion 1: STANDS WITH REWORDING, second sentence to read "실제 주문 순서로 돌리면 2010-03~2026-10-07 구간에서 v10 은 연 32~37%(보고 58.4%), PRESET_A 는 연 11~19% 입니다. 보고 수치의 종료일(2026-11-06)까지 넣으면 미국 구간 기준 약 2~3%p 더 낮습니다." Conclusion 2: STANDS WITH REWORDING, "v1 보다 압도적이지 않습니다. 등록 조건에서 PRESET_A 미국만은 v1 과 같은 수준(+0.5 / +1.2%p)이고 수수료 2배에서 탈락해 통과는 0개입니다. 같은 규칙을 수수료 0.30bp 에 적용하면 통과하고 유리한 가정을 모두 겹치면 약 +8%p 이지만, 실제 밤 자료가 있는 2001년 이후에는 v1 이하(2015~2026-08 -13.4%p)이고 브레이크가 하루만 늦어도 -3.9 / -7.7%p 이며 대표값은 최대 약 24% 로 30% 기준에 못 미칩니다" (full text in issue E1 item 1). Conclusion 3: STANDS WITH REWORDING, "살릴 수 있는 부분은 작고, 통과한 것은 없으며, 앞으로의 기록으로도 증명하기 어렵습니다. T5 는 총자산의 15% 를 이자 없는 선물 계좌로 옮기고 남은 85% 로 v1 을 운용하면서 v1 보유 중에만 밤 선물 1배를 더하는 형태로, 2001년 이후 실제 밤 자료에서 v1 대비 연 +1.5~+1.6%p(t 0.5)였고 등록 규칙은 통과하지 못했습니다" (issues B1, B2, B3). Conclusion 4: STANDS, with the 30% bar and the US-only margin sentence added (issue D2) and the re-entry conditions added (issue D1).

open_points: The original engines g2.py, uni.py and ext.py are not in the upload, so 'the original sized the Korean night after the fact' stays an inference. plan.py alone cannot settle which row holds the Korean night.

My three engine results use 12 and 6 seeds, not 30: one-day brake delay -3.93 / -7.71, stacked favourable case +8.13 / +8.55 (CAGR 24.38% / 39.63%), stacked with one-day delay +2.12 / -0.89. Signs are stable across the seeds I ran; the author should re-run with the 30 seeds of run_fix.py before printing them (ms1f.measure_one(P3, bn, 'C', 2, 0.004, 0, 0.25, 1) and measure_one(replace(P3, c_us=0.00003), bn, 'M', 2, 0.004, 1, 0.25, 0 or 1)).

Whether the same-close brake fills near the 16:00 ET reference price on large loss days is unmeasured. The backtest books the reduction at the close price with only the per-side fee, and the event cannot run on CME half days.
PRESET_A US-only with whole MNQ contracts at 80M KRW was not measured on the MS1 bases (the contract-size check covers T5 and T1 only), so its near-parity with v1 is for fractional contracts.

The real all-in MNQ cost per side, including slippage against the QQQ open and close prints, is unmeasured. The 0.14~0.53bp range is commission plus ticks at today's index level and was several times higher in bp at past index levels.

T5 was not measured with interest on the 15% futures account or with the dividend credit. My arithmetic, not a run: roughly +0.1~0.3 and +0.4~0.6 %p a year in its favour, which does not change its failure at the registered double fee.
v1 was never computed under the upload's conventions (no signal delay, dividends credited), so the section 1 figures cannot be compared with v1 at all; only the section 3 comparison is like for like.

Not re-verified by me: the phase-1 lane statistics quoted in section 1 (correlations, shuffle and placebo tests, the -6% shock test), the Kelly estimates, the margin event counts for 1999-2026, the last-month losses, and the eng.py real-order tables.
